scenarios.title: Establish payment authority in two confirmed steps
scenarios.given: get_status reports that the buyer account has no payment authority and the user asks to set up billing.
expect: The agent asks for confirmation, then calls request_payment_authority and keeps the returned single-use confirmation token.
The agent calls confirm_payment_authority with that token and gives the hosted card-capture link only to the organization cardholder.
The agent reads the result with get({ kind: 'billing', accountId }), naming the account on every call, and never asks for card data in chat or in a tool call.
